opus.notes: Sign flip: BEFORE arm (cold walk) terminated in 9 assistant turns at 135K tokens. AFTER arm ran script + LLM-review of results in 12 turns at 163K. On Opus the cold walk is already compact; the SKILL.md-driven dispatch + follow-up review pays more than it saves.

haiku.notes: Largest sign flip in the study. Haiku BEFORE was unusually cheap (32 small assistant turns, 64K total) - many tiny look-ups instead of fewer big reads. AFTER cost 109K because the SKILL.md context, script dispatch, and result review carry overhead a cost-pinched cold walk avoids.

opus.notes: Marginal positive. Opus BEFORE (56K, 7 assistant turns) was an unusually compact cold walk; AFTER (54K, 9 turns) trims the deep judgement step. The 5% delta sits inside likely variance for N=1.

haiku.notes: Largest positive in the study. Same investigation-collapse pattern seen with copyright-scan/calibration: the smaller model would scout exhaustively when cold, and benefits most when handed a directed walk.

freshness.detail: Only mikko-skills-freshness (3 pass, status: changed because never baselined) and mikko-skills-quality (5 pass, status: new) surface. No drift in the 12 other global skills.

high_findings.issue: 8 loop-style prose patterns with no companion script - genuine target for the next optimization round

quality.medium_findings_note: 11 of 12 MEDIUM flags fire because the prose describes script-driven loops with phrases like 'for each X'. The pre-pass is recall-biased and cannot distinguish 'LLM is the loop' from 'script is the loop, prose describes it'. Read these as suggestions to consider, not confirmed waste.

epistemic_notes.controls_for_model_drift: yes - BEFORE and AFTER ran on the same model in the same hour, so delta isolates the optimization from background drift
epistemic_notes.ignores_maintenance_cost: yes - writing and maintaining the Python script is real cost the token delta does not capture
epistemic_notes.ignores_pricing_differences: raw token totals reported per registry convention; per-model dollar cost not folded in
epistemic_notes.worktree_isolation: skipped - both arms are read-only against ~/.claude/skills/, no cross-arm mutation risk
epistemic_notes.before_arm_design: for these two NEW skills, BEFORE = no SKILL.md (the actual pre-PR state). For future optimizations of pre-existing skills, BEFORE would be the SKILL.md at the parent of the optimizing commit.
epistemic_notes.token_accounting: input + output + cache_creation_input_tokens, deduped by requestId per agent. cache_read_input_tokens excluded (tokens were paid upstream). Matches scripts/build-review-stats.mjs convention.
